contact.faq.title: Frequently
contact.faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions we receive
contact.faq.provider.question: How do I join as a service provider?
contact.faq.provider.answer: Click "Register" in the top menu, fill in the required details and choose the service you offer. The process is simple and short.
contact.faq.advantages.question: What are the benefits of using All Sherut for service providers?
contact.faq.advantages.answer: The customers who contact you are your direct customers. The platform is designed to present service providers clearly, professionally and accessibly — so every inquiry comes directly to you, without intermediaries.
contact.faq.fees.question: Is there a commission or payment per customer?
contact.faq.fees.answer: No. The system operates on a fixed monthly payment only. There are no additional costs and no charges per inquiry — a simple, stable and transparent model.
contact.faq.trial.question: Is there a trial month?
contact.faq.trial.answer: Yes. Every service provider gets a free month to enjoy exposure, inquiries and potential customers — without commitment.
contact.faq.howItWorks.question: How does it work in practice for service providers?
contact.faq.howItWorks.answer: After opening a profile, the platform displays your areas of expertise, experience, pricing and contact methods. Customers see your details and contact you directly.
contact.faq.communication.question: Is communication with customers done through the website?
contact.faq.communication.answer: Communication is done directly with you — by phone, WhatsApp or any way you choose. The goal is to connect you with customers in the simplest way.
contact.faq.security.question: What about privacy and information security?
contact.faq.security.answer: We use advanced security measures to keep all your data safe and ensure a secure user experience.
